title: Chat confirm card: after 确认 the transcript shows the internal continuation prompt as the user's own bubble (「[HITL pa_…] The operator approved the `create_record` call… Acknowledge the outcome…」)
body:
coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_6eb9ec2e0e3f410b91239dab7a337b9e

Filing gate: **① a defect measured on staging** (cloud#3342 acceptance reads for cloud#3565, maintainer-authorized 2026-11-05).

**Business reason.** After a person clicks 确认 on the chat's confirm card, their own side of the conversation shows a long English message they never wrote. It carries internal ids and a JSON result, ending 「Acknowledge the outcome concisely and continue the user's task.」 It looks like a bug or a leak to a customer, on the very path cloud#3565 just shipped.

**Reader who acts.** The ui lane (`domain:ui`).

**Dedupe.**
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack useHitlInChat is:issue`: 1 hit, the triage seat post, which only mentions it.
- `"The operator approved"`: 0 hits.

## 维护者速读

聊天里点「确认」之后，对话里会以用户自己的身份冒出一大段英文，内容是系统发给模型的续写指令，带记录 id 和 JSON。这段应该对用户隐藏，或者换成一行「已确认」。

## Measured (staging `bd085bb0`, `os-4e4qa4`, every confirm in 10 runs)

- After 确认, a user bubble appears: 「[HITL pa_2b60f90b-…] The operator approved the `create_record` call. It executed successfully with result: {"status":"written","operation":"create","objectName":"jpph_customer","recordId":"u_Vo_YLw7bmg9wuS","link":"[验收客户 R5](/record/jpph_customer/u_Vo_YLw7bmg9wuS)",…}. Acknowledge the outcome concisely and continue the user's task.」 The same happens for `update_record`.
- Source: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useHitlInChat.ts` ~333–344 builds this text and sends it with `sendMessage` (the comment at ~81 says so), so it renders as an ordinary user message and stays in the stored history.

## Two smaller things seen on the same path

- After an update, the assistant's reply sometimes names the record by its id: 「vhGuAdkNThenRvKh 的状态已改为 Active」 instead of 「验收客户 R2」. Other runs use the name.
- After the chat writes the record, the record page behind the dock does not refresh. The stage bar still shows Prospect until a reload.

## Acceptance

- After 确认 or 取消, no continuation text appears as a user bubble: hide it, or show a one-line system note such as 「已确认」.
- The model still receives the continuation.
- A reloaded conversation does not show it either.

Related: cloud#3565, cloud#3342.
